label: Bible Study
prompt: Pilate saith unto him, What is _____? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verse: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
note: Pilate's famous question — asked of the one who had said, 'I am the way, the truth, and the life.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Mercy unto you, and peace, and _____, be multiplied.
verse: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
note: Jude's greeting is a triple helping — mercy, peace, and love — and he wants all three multiplied.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on _____, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
verse: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
note: One reluctant sermon, and all Nineveh put on sackcloth — from the greatest of them to the least.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the _____ that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verse: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
note: The world-beater isn't willpower — John says the victory that overcomes the world is faith itself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and _____ evil?
verse: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
note: God's own résumé for Job: perfect, upright, fearing God, and one that 'escheweth evil' — turns his back on it.
